summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG following Bearers from the Wayside Fire along Broken Lantern Road into the Ashen Abbey, its Burned Nave and Bell Crypt. The main-place referee owns quest and encounter orchestration; player, combat, character persistence and UI scripts provide the shared play systems, while the solo Veil place hosts character menus.
places: places/main/ - playable Z01 from the Wayside Fire through the road, Bailiff's Court, Wax Veil, Penitent Climb and Ashen Abbey to the Burned Nave and Bell Crypt; sim.js coordinates quests, packs, progression, boss respawn and ambience/music.

places/main/cells/ - three authored cells with 222 placements; x0z-2.scene contains Abbey wing colliders and blueprint placeholders for the Nave and Ninth Bell; the Abbey façade is an offline Blender build in art/abbey/facade.py.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, atmosphere and procedural vegetation configuration.
places/veil/ - ephemeral solo Lantern Shrine menu stage above the ravine; the hidden menu body is parked here.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - authored shrine ledge, cliffs, far ridge, spawn and menu-stage environment.
places/veil/sim.js - selects menu theme and wind when no eligible Bearer is on main.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main default place, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival behavior, nametag and desktop/touch action routing.
templates/player.js - Bladewraith body, humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js behavior, layout and carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - Z01 referee for quest stages, NPCs, enemy packs, progression, reward turn-ins, boss respawn and ambience/music.
places/main/cells/ - authored playable dressing from camp and road through Bailiff arena, Wax Veil, Penitent Climb, Abbey yard, nave and crypt.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - authored menu-stage shrine/ravine and spawn/environment.
places/veil/sim.js - Veil wind and menu-theme selection when no eligible Bearer is on main.
scripts/arrival.js - world doorway behavior; saves an active Bearer when leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player and arrival behavior reuse it.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - character-table schema and realm room/name registry for player menus and UI.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml and scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denomination/formatting, drops, quest rewards, sell values and shop stock used by sim, combat payouts, shop and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - hero/skill/enemy and Bailiff/Ringer tuning consumed by player, enemy, boss and HUD systems.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared Z01 floor/area and Abbey/Nave/Crypt geometry; terrain, player movement and zone banners use it.
scripts/lib/data/menu-shot.yml and scripts/lib/data/models.js - Veil camera framing and CDN model IDs/heights/body(kind) helper used by camera and actor spawning.
scripts/lib/frames.js, scripts/lib/data/ui-kit.js and scripts/lib/shop-ui.js - shared HUD styling and shop-panel presentation used by UI.
art/roadkit/common.py - offline Blender construction/material/render helpers imported by roadkit and Abbey builders.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/veil/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/ui.js - default HUD/menu renderer.
scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update; scripts/bailiff.js and scripts/ringer.js - onSpawn, update.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, rollName, roster, create, load, save, remove.
scripts/lib/shop.js - owned, shopInput; scripts/lib/shop-ui.js - shopPanel; scripts/controls.js - default touch-surface selector.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT, body; scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - NAVE_DOOR, NAVE, NAVE_HALF, CRYPT, BELL, floorDist, areaAt.
scripts/gen/ossuary-cart.js - geometry, collider; scripts/gen/censer.js - geometry; scripts/gen/penitent-wheel.js - geometry, collider.
scripts/camera.js - onInput, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/lib/frames.js - FRAME_CSS.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields including seen areas, quest/reward claims and ringerKilled; packed position is separate and UI/movement scratch is transient.
scripts/player.js - active body's movement, combat, death/i-frame and skill timers, menu/selection scratch, area/banner/foe projection, floor access gates and selected Bearer hydration/save.
places/main/sim.js - per-player quest stage/dialog/kills/saints and claimed rewards; place NPC/shop range behavior, enemy packs, progression, Ringer spawn/respawn and ambience/music orchestration.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and eligible nearby Bearers' XP/copper/kills/shards payouts.
scripts/bailiff.js - Bailiff hp/phases/casts, arena reset, ledger pillars/walkers and Fray; publishes place.state.boss.
scripts/ringer.js - Ringer hp/phases/casts/adds, engagement/reset and defeat; publishes place.state.ringer and marks participating Bearers ringerKilled.
scripts/lib/shop.js - trade validation and buyer copper, tonics, bag and maxHp mutations; shop-open state is on player.state.
scripts/camera.js and scripts/ui.js - camera zoom/follow/menu framing and presentation of menu/gameplay panels from player/place state.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches scripts/player.js through templates/player.js and maps desktop/touch actions; UI menu actions → player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout.
player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove using caller-owned character rows; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil → realm/Bearer screens remain state-driven, with no characters in that place.
scripts/controls.js selects the menu touch surface when player/charId is absent or menu is active, and while shop/bag is open; otherwise world.config.yaml supplies fight controls.
scripts/ui.js renders menus and HUD from player/place state → menu/shop/combat actions return through player.js; shop-ui.js presents shop buttons and shop.js validates trades.
scripts/camera.js reads target.state.menu and menu-shot.yml for Veil framing; entering play transitions to follow view.
player.js saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus position periodically/on rest → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active character leaving main.

player.js uses veilfall-map.js floorDist for reachable goals and movement/dash → ABBEY floor opens at quest stage 4+ (or abbeyOpenAll), Nave/Crypt floor at stage 10+ (or abbeyOpenAll); stage 10 entry into NAVE_IN advances quest to 11.
main sim advances Abbey chapter stages 5–10 (yard, six foes, three saints, door, Maelin); stages 11–13 track Nave entry, Ringer defeat and Maelin turn-in for the once-only Z01-MAIN-07 reward.
main sim spawns scripts/ringer.js at the Bell Crypt using models.js body('ringer'); the boss publishes place.state.ringer → ui.js displays its engaged boss bar and phase hint.

Ringer defeat writes player.state.ringerKilled for crypt participants → main sim consumes it at quest stage 11; combat payout gives XP/copper, and Maelin's stage-12 turn-in claims reward and raises maxHp.

main sim selects pack kind/model → combat.yml tunes stats and models.js supplies CDN bodies; wax-pack.js resolves ordinary kills, while main and Veil sims coordinate ambience/music through the room-shared jukebox.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire camp props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter varied by parameters and seeds, built with vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - road, arena, Wax Veil approach, Veil ashlar and Abbey door braziers; kind/dimensions select forms, seed varies geometry.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge forms vary by kind/dimensions; the unique Lantern Shrine exports structure and hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing generators sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js and its soot-stained wax palette.

scripts/gen/abbey-litter.js and abbey-court.js - Abbey yard dressing; litter varies by kind/seed/transform, court makes ringed slabs and a clear local -Z door path; penitent-wheel.js adds seeded road forms.
scripts/gen/ossuary-cart.js - bespoke static bone-cart mesh/collider placed once in the Abbey approach; parameters vary its tip.

scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - shared body/input locomotion on player and wax enemy actors; CDN bodies/heights vary by kind; art/roadkit and art/abbey builders author static models using shared roadkit helpers.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural enemy-figure generator; current wax actors use CDN models.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is exactly scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; seen and ringerKilled are persistent per-Bearer, while area/banner/foe, menu and movement state remain transient. Add persistent fields to CHAR_KEYS.

Character rows are caller-owned and realm-bound; character.js scopes roster/load/save by owner and realm, while live names are unique per realm. realms.yml room IDs are routing identities, not places in this tree.
The Veil is solo and ephemeral, has no characters, and parks the hidden menu body at its origin; menu framing in camera.js is tuned against that stage's shrine/ledge layout.
The music jukebox is room-shared, not owned independently by each place: main sim changes it for road/fight/boss/Abbey only when an eligible Bearer is on main; Veil supplies the menu theme otherwise.

Player attacks mutate enemy.state.hp; wax-pack.js resolves ordinary-enemy death, XP and kill credit. Ringer boss state is separate: it scales from crypt participants, resets after 6 s with the crypt empty/downed, and main sim respawns its dead entity after 120 s when the crypt is clear.

ABBEY_ROAD/ABBEY/NAVE/CRYPT coordinates in veilfall-map.js are world metres; player.js gates Abbey and Nave floor by quest state or abbeyOpenAll. The Wax Veil seal-side boundary remains coupled to the placed seal position/orientation.
